description: Unit tests for the DateOrDatetimeEditor class, testing date and datetime parsing and formatting.

classes.name: DateOrDatetimeEditorTest
classes.description: Test class for DateOrDatetimeEditor's date and datetime formatting and parsing.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize the DateOrDatetimeEditor instance before each test.

methods.name: getAsText_shouldPrintDateWithoutTime
methods.description: Tests that the editor prints only date when time is zero.

methods.name: getAsText_shouldPrintDateAndTimeWithTime
methods.description: Tests that the editor prints date and time correctly for a datetime value.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldHandleDate
methods.description: Tests parsing of a date string without time component.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldHandleDateAndTime
methods.description: Tests parsing of a datetime string including time.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldFailOnPartialDate
methods.description: Ensures error is thrown when input date string is partial.

methods.name: setAsText_shouldFailOnPartialDateAndTime
methods.description: Ensures error is thrown when input datetime string is partial.
